text:
Nina (PM): quick sync on enterprise launch gates for audit + BYOK. need final decision by EOD Fri.
Kevin (Eng): list our must-haves vs stretch?
Nina (PM): must: append-only audit stream, tenant retention toggle, BYOK MVP for export. stretch: indexed historical search, archive UI.
Elaine (Security): SOC2/ISO constraints: tamper proofing, key usage logs, rotation policy. HSM compatibility is "ask not block" but doc required.
Jordan (SRE): note: append-only storage + indexing increases IOPS and egress. for 1000 enterprise tenants, estimate 2x storage IOPS unless we offload to a dedicated ingest cluster.
Sam (Sales): 2 customers will go dark without BYOK day1. they also want 90-180 days of searchable logs.
Kevin (Eng): engineering can deliver BYOK MVP in ~6w if we avoid full HSM path and skip search. full HSM + attestation ~12w.
Nina (PM): proposal: ship BYOK MVP with export wrapping + immutable stream + tenant retention toggle. defer full index search to phase 2. use a compatibility shim for legacy logs to avoid blocking customers.
Elaine (Security): acceptable if we implement chain-hash for new writes and a documented migration plan. require key usage audit logging for 180 days.
Jordan (SRE): operational gates: legal-hold flag (prevent deletes), backfill/runbook for re-signing legacy records, and alerts on failed immutable writes.
Kevin (Eng): dev tasks: implement append-only topic with prefix locking; sign records with chaining hash (sha256(prev || record)); BYOK handshake to wrap customer keys. retention config example:
Kevin (Eng): ```
retention_policy:
  tenant_tier: enterprise
  default_ttl_days: 90
  legal_hold: false
  archive_after_days: 180
  export_allowed_with_byo_key: true
```
Sam (Sales): can we include a cost note in PRD for retention tiers? Procurement needs it.
Nina (PM): yes. Jordan, can you prototype sizing and 95th percentile cost estimate by Thu EOD?
Jordan (SRE): will do, using current telemetry + 2x safety factor.
Elaine (Security): I'll draft the KMS attestation checklist and required controls, plus the updated threat model.
Kevin (Eng): blocker: migration for existing logs — force migration or shim? Migration pre-launch is expensive.
Nina (PM): leaning shim to unblock pilots. flag legacy records in UI/docs.
Elaine (Security): shim ok if we surface legacy status and preserve audit trail; should not weaken tamper guarantees.
Kevin (Eng): shim approach: keep legacy records readable, add a bridging signature on next write. works for pilots.
Sam (Sales): that should be fine with contract notes.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled config rollout for staging retention matrix 2023-11-02T07:00:00Z (info).
Nina (PM): action items: Jordan - sizing Thu. Elaine - KMS checklist Thu. Kevin - chain-hash spike + legal-hold API next week. Sam - consolidate customer deadlines Fri. I'll update PRD and circulate. :thumbsup:
